title: Congo: The Movie: The Lost City of Zinj
overview:
Where You Are the Endangered Species!

Deep in the heart of the darkest region of the Congo, you are on a diamond expedition to the legendary ruins of the Lost City of Zinj. Everyone in your party has mysteriously disappeared. Alone, you still must complete the expedition and uncover the diamonds, while another team is competing to unearth the treasures of Zinj - and nothing will stop them.

- This 360° action thriller leads you through level after level of suspense-filled action where you'll battle ferocious gray gorillas, giant mutant mosquitoes, enormous killer spiders and more!
- Fight your way through four distinct gameplay environments from the movie.
- Changing perspectives put you right in the middle of intense 3-D rendered Congo action!
- Based on the best selling novel by Michael Crichton and the Paramount Pictures movie release.
